blocks.label: Q1
blocks.instruction: Q1.Observe the picture and answer the questions. 5 x 2 =10M

pictures.what: bank building with 'BANK' on the pediment (Q1 1)
protein foods: steak, chicken leg, fish steaks, fried eggs, beans/pulses, 'PROTEIN' shaker, cheese (Q1 3)
electrician in helmet, gloves and tool belt at an open electrical panel (Q1 4)
box-type solar cooker with glass lid propped open and pots inside (Q1 5)

blocks.notes: Each sub-question is two-part (1 mark per part assumed). Sub-items numbered '1)'..'5)'. Item 4 has stray space 'fixes the wires .'. 'Electrician' is not in Ch 1-5 text (general knowledge). Answer lines for item 3 continue at top of p.2 (not a break).

blocks.label: Q2
blocks.notes: Space before full stop in 'following .' kept. Answers in textbook: Khetala (Ch1), Uruka (Ch1), Gond art (Ch4), frog (Ch3). 'specialist' singular kept; 'live on water' kept.

blocks.label: Q3
blocks.instruction: Q3. Give two examples of each- 3 x 1 = 3M
blocks.notes: Two blanks per item (0.5 each). Item 2 'Traditional food of Andhra Pradesh': textbook (Ch5) names only Ugadi Pachadi — second example needs general knowledge; flag. Item 3 'Indian tribes': textbook gives Jenu Kurubas (Ch4); second from general knowledge.

blocks.label: Q4
blocks.instruction: Q4. Match the method of cooking and with its name. 3 x 1 = 3M

pictures.what: covered pot of water on stove with food submerged (boiling)
covered pot with perforated tray above steaming water (steaming)
oven with food on a grill rack under heating element (grilling or roasting)
frying pan with food and rising heat on stove (frying)
round charcoal barbecue grill on legs with food on grate (grilling or roasting)

blocks.notes: PRINTED MARKS MISMATCH: 6 pictures and 6 names (baking, roasting, grilling, boiling, steaming, frying) but marks printed '3 x 1 = 3M'. Recorded as 6 x 0.5 = 3 to keep the printed 3 marks; owner to confirm. Stray 'and' in 'cooking and with its name' kept. Pictures 3 (oven grill rack) and 5 (barbecue grill) are ambiguous between grilling and roasting — accept either pairing. Names column order: baking, roasting, grilling, boiling, steaming, frying. Ch5 (cooking methods list).

blocks.label: Q5
blocks.instruction: Q5. Answer the questions based on the picture given- 1 X 5 = 5M

pictures.what: Rs 500 SPECIMEN banknote, front (Gandhi portrait, RESERVE BANK OF INDIA, Ashoka emblem at right) and back (Red Fort, Swachh Bharat logo, language panel)

blocks.notes: Marks '1 X 5 = 5M' printed beside the picture, not on the heading line — instruction string will need fallbackText. Item e) 'Encircle the national emblem ... on the above note' is a picture-interaction item (label) — drawing must show the emblem as a selectable region. Item b) 'How many languages' depends on the language panel (15 panel languages + Hindi + English = 17) — drawing must make that countable or accept a range; flag. Item d) 'Which famous Indian prominent leader's image' (redundant 'famous ... prominent') kept; curly apostrophe. Ch2 activity (currency note).

blocks.label: Q6
blocks.notes: No space after 'Q6.' and after 'a)' / 'b)'. a) grasshopper (Ch3); b) bajra (Ch5 mentions jowar and bajra; riddle 'round and grey ... winter roti').

blocks.label: Q7
blocks.notes: Column A 1) Chinar 2) Jenu 3) Tumri 4) Fish; Column B a) Honey b) Chhattisgarh c) Fins d) Uttarakhand. Key: Chinar-Chhattisgarh (Ch1 Chinar river, Kanker), Jenu-Honey (Ch4), Tumri-Uttarakhand (Ch4), Fish-Fins (Ch3).

blocks.label: Q8
blocks.instruction: Q8. Circle the one which does not belong to the group. 4 x 1 = 4M
blocks.notes: 1. Ant Wasp Butterfly Termite — ambiguous (Butterfly: not a colony insect; Termite: not in textbook, not Hymenoptera) — flag. 2. Lemon (not a cereal). 3. Marigold (flower vs herbs/medicinal; Ch4 lists marigold and ajwain) — likely, check. 4. Idli (not junk food).

blocks.notes: Uses '×' character. Item 2 'Who is a nature scientist? Write about its role.' — 'its' for a person kept. Item 5 printed '5.What' (no space). Topics: Van Mahotsav (Ch1), nature scientist (Ch3), balanced diet (Ch5), ATM (Ch2), sacred groves (Ch4). Item 5 answer lines continue on p.6 (not a break).

pictures.what: electric train / metro with overhead pantograph on tracks

blocks.notes: Image shows '5 x 1 = 5 M'; text cache has '5x1=5M' — image wins, fallbackText for instruction. Flyover (Ch2), bridge (Ch1/Ch2), metro/train (Ch2), hornbill (Ch3); dragonfly not in textbook. Metro vs train vs electric train: accept several.

blocks.notes: Colon after 'Q11' kept. Items numbered '1.State' etc. without space. blocks.label: Q12
blocks.instruction: Q12. Answers the following questions. 2 x 2 = 4 M
blocks.notes: Typo 'Answers' kept. Image shows '2 x  2 = 4 M'; cache '2x 2=4M' — fallbackText. Item 1 'any two super food' (singular) kept. Super food (Ch5), first-aid box (Ch4).

blocks.label: Q13
blocks.notes: Image '3 x 2 = 6 M'; cache '3x2=6M' — fallbackText. Items 2 and 3 printed '2.We' / '3.Drinking' (no space). Interdependence (Ch3), junk food (Ch5), water (Ch5).

blocks.label: Q14
blocks.instruction: Q14.  Draw 1 junk food , 1 healthy food , a bird and colour it-- 3+ 2 = 5M
blocks.notes: Marks '3+ 2 = 5M' = 3 for drawings (1 each) + 2 for colouring; no picture printed, blank space. Spaces before commas and '--' kept. Activity — rubric + owner check; render as draw/activity item(s) with 0.5-multiples summing to 5.

blocks.label: Q15
blocks.instruction: Q15. Locate the state in the given map. 1x 5 = 5 M

pictures.what: outline political map of India with state boundaries, no names (whole of p.8)

blocks.notes: States: 1.Madhya Pradesh 2. Karnataka 3. Uttarakhand 4. Andhra Pradesh 5. Tripura. Marks written '1x 5' (reversed order) kept. Map is on a separate page (p.8) after Q15 text on p.7. Must be drawn as map with numbered blank regions (or select-the-state). States tie to Ch3 (Pachmarhi MP, Tripura), Ch4 (Karnataka, Uttarakhand), Ch5 (Andhra Pradesh).

markArithmetic: Sec 1: 10+4+3+3+5 = 25 = printed (25 MARKS). Sec 2: 2+4+4+15+5 = 30 = printed (30MARKS). Sec 3: 5+4+6+5+5 = 25 = printed (25 MARKS). 25+30+25 = 80 = printed Marks: 80. All match. Only internal mismatch: Q4 shows 6 match pairs for '3 x 1 = 3M' (treated as 6 x 0.5).
issues: Page-missing verdict: complete — header miscount. Header says 'Total No. of printed pages: 09' but every footer reads 'Page N of 8' (1-8 all present), questions run Q1-Q15 with no gap, each section and the total sum exactly, and no question breaks off (Q1.3 and Q9.5 answer lines simply continue on the next page; Q15's map is p.8).
Q4: 6 pictures / 6 cooking names but printed '3 x 1 = 3M' — record as 6 x 0.5? Owner to confirm. Grilling vs roasting pictures (3 and 5) ambiguous.
Q5: currency-note picture must be redrawn (Rs 500 specimen); e) 'Encircle the national emblem' needs an interactive/labelled region; b) language count depends on the drawn language panel.
Q15: map of India must be drawn with numbered state regions; map sits on p.8 separate from the question.
Q14: drawing/colouring activity (5 marks) — cannot be auto-marked; parent check.
Q8.1 (Ant/Wasp/Butterfly/Termite) and Q8.3 (Marigold/Tulsi/Amla/Ajwain) have more than one defensible odd one.
Q3.2: textbook gives only one Andhra Pradesh traditional food (Ugadi Pachadi); two required.
Off-textbook content: electrician (Q1.4), dragonfly (Q10), termite (Q8.1), national emblem (Q5e).
